Alex T: Heads-up — noticed console is showing project_id for some SA exec calls in traces. Could be PII for customers?
Samir: oof, where?
Alex T: eng-runtime traces, the 'effective_identity' banner includes project=proj-1234 in breadcrumbs. Screenshot incoming.
Katie P: screenshot?
Alex T: (uploaded image) — but repro with curl:
Alex T: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Source: project=proj-1234" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Samir: hmm we add origin header for routing, but shouldn't persist in UI unless consented. config flag `console.show_origin`?
Katie P: we already have sampling flag for telemetry. This is about showing in dashboard. Need privacy review.
maya (infra-bot): Incident check: no active incidents. Logged event id=evt_78a9
Alex T: Proposal: strip project id before storing traces, keep a hashed project_id for deduping + allow opt-in show in console via admin flag.
Samir: :+1: prefer hashing + admin opt-in. Also need migration of existing traces (backfill scrub) and a rollout plan.
Katie P: UX: in console hover show 'project hidden — admin view only'. For rollouts, start in dedicated only then hosted.
Samir: @Katie P can you draft a short copy? I'll draft the telemetry change and migration script.
Katie P: yup. putting in PR for copy. ETA EOD.
Alex T: thanks. filing a GH issue for migration and a change note.
maya (infra-bot): Created issue #4689 by Alex T: 'scrub traces of project ids; add admin opt-in'.
Samir: moving to triage channel.
